description: Market data for FX Derivatives trades #26-27 (5Y USD/TWD non-deliverable cross-currency swap hedging the TSM-ADR FX exposure; 3M USD/JPY FX forward carry overlay). See docs/design/AITrade_quantlib_portfolio_marketdata.md §1.5, §2.5, §4.6.

portfolio.instrument: 5Y USD/TWD non-deliverable cross-currency swap — hedge TSM ADR FX (trade #2)
portfolio.ql_engine: two IborLegs + FX notional resets, multi-curve DiscountingSwapEngine on FX-basis-adjusted discount curve
portfolio.fwd_method: CIP-derived: F = S * (1 + SOFR*T) / (1 + TWD_rate*T) — no free TWD NDF forward feed exists (EMTA retired)
portfolio.notes: USD/TWD spot is the dominant risk driver; the TWD rate differential is second-order (hold fixed or parallel-shift in stress).

portfolio.fwd_method: CIP-derived: F = S * (1 + SOFR*T) / (1 + TONAR*T), TONAR from boj_tonar

notes: 4-year+ lookback captures the 2022 USD strength episode and TWD devaluation moves for Taiwan-geopolitical stress calibration (§2.8).

FX forward points are NOT downloaded — no free NDF/forward-point feed survives (EMTA retired, TAIFEX 404). Forwards are CIP-derived at pricing time from spot + short rates (SOFR from the rates pipeline, TONAR from boj_tonar, TWD policy rate from pricing_constants below).
USD discount leg uses SOFR already captured by the rates pipeline (data/marketdata/rates/nyfed_sofr_rates.csv) — not re-downloaded here.

pricing_constants.TWD_DISCOUNT_RATE_notes: CBC rediscount (policy) rate, currently 2.00%. Anchors the flat TWD OIS curve for the TWD leg of trade #26. Per §4.6 this changes ~4x/year at scheduled CBC board meetings (headline news) — DO NOT automate; update this constant manually on board-decision days. The floating overnight interbank call-loan rate (~0.83%, CBC lp-696-2.html) is a JS-rendered HTML table with no CSV/JSON API and is not automated.
pricing_constants.day_count: ACT/360 for USD & TWD money-market legs; CIP tenor T in years

ecb_fx.name: ECB Daily Reference Rates — USD/JPY cross (primary)
ecb_fx.description: ECB publishes EUR-base reference rates daily (~16:00 CET). USD/JPY is derived as (JPY/EUR)/(USD/EUR) from the two series below — no FRED needed (FRED FX series 504-timeout per §4.6). ECB does NOT carry TWD (use fed_h10). Primary spot for trade #27.

fed_h10.name: Fed H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates — USD/TWD (primary) + USD/JPY (backup)
fed_h10.description: Federal Reserve H.10 historical FX tables (one HTML table per pair, Date + Rate columns, units = foreign-ccy per USD, 'ND' on holidays). Updated Mondays ~16:15 ET; coverage 2000-present in a single fetch. Primary source for USD/TWD spot (trade #26, dominant risk driver) and backup for USD/JPY. Date format in the table is DD-MMM-YY.

boj_tonar.name: Bank of Japan — Uncollateralized Overnight Call Rate (TONAR, JPY OIS anchor)
boj_tonar.description: BOJ Time-Series API (launched Feb 2026, free, no auth). Series db=FM01 code=STRDCLUCON = 'Call Rate, Uncollateralized Overnight, Average (Daily)', unit % p.a. Anchors the JPY OIS curve for CIP forward derivation of trade #27 (r_JPY in F = S*(1+r_USD*T)/(1+r_JPY*T)). NOTE: the API's startDate parameter takes YYYYMM (month) format even though the series is daily; the response carries SURVEY_DATES as YYYYMMDD integers (null on non-business days).

cbc_twd_spot.name: CBC (Taiwan) — USD/TWD interbank closing rate (NDF settlement fixing)
cbc_twd_spot.description: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) daily NT$/US$ interbank closing rate, lp-700-2.html. This IS the reference rate USD/TWD NDFs settle against in practice — the NDF fixing for trade #26. Paginated HTML (20 rows/page, ~166 pages back to ~2013); page URL pattern lp-700-2-{page}-20.html (page 1 = most recent). No CSV/JSON API (EMTA retired, TAIFEX dailyFXRates 404). Date format YYYY/MM/DD. Complements fed_h10 USD/TWD (Fed rate and CBC fixing differ slightly).
